text.tspan: Measured in tonnes of refined material. The amounts of refined and raw materials differ because refining
removes impurities and adjusts the composition to meet specific standards.

tspan.tspan: USGS – Mineral Commodity Summaries (2026); BGS – World Mineral Statistics (2026)
The sum of all countries may exceed World data on certain years, due to discrepancies between data sources.
